title: RPC portmapper service detected on a critical asset

case_origin.source: Tenable vulnerability export supplied for thesis experiment

experimental_selection_reason: Low-severity service-detection finding with no remediation text in the source; selected to test cautious handling of limited evidence.

finding.synopsis: An ONC RPC portmapper is running on the remote host.
finding.description:
The RPC portmapper is running on this port.

The portmapper allows someone to get the port number of each RPC service running on the remote host by sending either multiple lookup requests or a DUMP request.
